purpose: Teach: 多少なりとも/殊に/ドロドロ/帰り際/頷い/はおり/わきまえ/大人しく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、多少なりとも勉強してんのか?
lines.en: Do you actually study at all, Riku?
lines.style: Playful jab with a sharp edge. Quick attack. Teasing him like she's testing whether he'll rise to it. Slight curl of amusement at the corner of her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、殊に数学が苦手だな、桜
lines.en: Yeah, well, you're especially bad at math, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry comeback. Measured and unhurried. Hitting back without heat — more of a verbal nudge than a punch. The faintest smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスニーカー、ドロドロじゃん
lines.en: Your sneakers are completely covered in mud, by the way.
lines.style: Casual observation delivered with mock concern. Light, almost conversational rhythm. Like she's not trying to embarrass him but is anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、帰り際に俺の机に絡むなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't mess with my desk on your way out, okay?
lines.style: Half-warning, half-plea. Exasperated but not genuinely angry. A little pleading underneath — he knows she does this on purpose.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生の話に頷いてたな
lines.en: You were actually paying attention during the lesson.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Softer than her usual edge. A beat of real noticing beneath the surface. Not quite a compliment, but close.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、おばあちゃんがくれたはおり似合うな、桜
lines.en: That haori your grandmother gave you looks really good on you.
lines.style: Sincere underneath the casual delivery. Held at arm's length like he's not quite sure how to say it. Warm but careful, slightly self-conscious.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先輩への礼儀わきまえろよ
lines.en: You should show some respect to your seniors, you know.
lines.style: Gentle correction with no real bite. Almost sisterly — she's not lecturing, more reminding him kindly. Slight teasing lilt underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図書室では大人しくしろよ、桜
lines.en: Keep it down in the library, will you?
lines.style: Quiet, firm but not unkind. The tone of someone who actually cares if he gets in trouble. Understated and direct, trailing softly.
